dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.content: Two heterogeneous robots (a legged Spot and a wheeled Fetch) operate in one shared multi-floor scene. Complete the benchmark objective: ensure that a robot reaches the object any_targets|0, and ensure that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0. Decide yourselves how to divide the work between the available robots and carry it out.

assessment.objective: Ensure that a robot reaches the object identified as any_targets|0 and that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.
constraints: Use the available Spot and Fetch robots in the shared multi-floor scene.
Choose the division of work between the robots without requiring further user direction.
assumptions: The robot reaching the object and the robot reaching the goal receptacle need not be distinct; assignment is left to the system.

mission.objective: Ensure that a robot reaches the object identified as any_targets|0 and that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.

tasks.description: The Spot robot reaches the object identified as any_targets|0.

execution_intent.objective: Reach the object identified as any_targets|0.

satisfaction.expected_effect: The Spot robot reaches the object identified as any_targets|0.

tasks.description: The Fetch robot reaches the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.

execution_intent.objective: Reach the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.

satisfaction.expected_effect: The Fetch robot reaches the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.
